cmd: cd /tmp && for u in 'https://developer.maersk.com/api-catalogue' 'https://developer.maersk.com/support/authorisation' 'https://developer.maersk.com/api-catalogue/track-and-trace-events' 'https://developer.maersk.com/api-catalogue/Track%20and%20Trace%20Plus' ; do echo "=== $u"; curl -sS --max-time 30 -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) Chrome/126' -o /tmp/m.html -w 'HTTP %{http_code} байт %{size_download}\n' "$u" || true; python3 -c "import re,sys;h=open('/tmp/m.html',encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').read();t=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',h,flags=re.S|re.I);t=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t);t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t);import textwrap;print(t[:1200])" 2>/dev/null; echo; done
